outer_split: leave one of eight acquisition sessions out
reference: 24D author features with inner-session-selected Ridge alpha
candidate: 16D sparse author features selected entirely inside each outer-training split
inner_selection: four-fold grouped CV by acquisition session; feature selection refit inside every inner-training fold

metrics.primary: equal-session mean Euclidean localization error in micrometres
metrics.secondary: chronological same-coordinate repeat error: each later session is predicted using only earlier acquisition sessions and only coordinates already measured earlier

claim_boundary: passing supports internal cross-session readout compression on one chip and one unidentified target; it is not independent-array external confirmation, quantum-computing advantage or speedup
